decisions.reason: As a newly launched core packaging product with its own page and very close fit to the firm's established reusable transport offer, it is likely to be retained.
This valve extends the firm's bulk-container system and was actively presented on its own page, so a large German packaging supplier would usually keep it unless early demand were clearly weak.
Although less prominently marketed, the take-back service matches the firm's move toward service-based, sustainable reusable packaging and is therefore more likely to be developed than withdrawn.
